title: Strengthenings of Mazur's Conjecture for Higher Heegner Points
summary: We establish quantitative strengthenings of Mazur's conjecture regarding the non-torsion property of higher Heegner points on modular and Shimura curves, confirming both a vertical version for sufficiently large powers $n$ and a horizontal version for primes $p \gg 1$. Distinct from previous strategies by Cornut and Vatsal that relied on Ratner's theorems on unipotent flows and required restrictive hypotheses on level structures, our approach circumvents these constraints by exploiting the interplay between Galois orbits and Hecke orbits.
